
The file was opened for `O_RDWR|O_CREATE|O_EXCL` which means that the open should have created the file anew if it didn't exist.  However it didn't work, so I think an intermediate directory must be missing.

I wonder if the cache got cleaned and the intermediate directory got removed between the open (which I don't see in your log).

Can you check to see if the intermediate directories are missing?

Commenting this code out in `vfs/cache.go` will fix it if that is the problem.

```go
	// Now tidy up any empty directories
	err = fs.Rmdirs(c.f, "")
	if err != nil {
		fs.Errorf(c.f, "Failed to remove empty directories from cache: %v", err)
	}
```

Can you try that?  If that works then I'll think of a better fix!

PS I see that file was opened with O_EXCL which I think I probably need to take more care with, but I don't think it is the problem in this case.

I see what is happening.  This is because you have the cache in `writes` mode which means it deletes the file after it is uploaded.


However I didn't remove the marker that the file exists in the cache.

The error is cosmetic only thankfully, but I'll fix it properly shortly.

Yes I thought it was something like that but better safe than sorry. I'm monitoring the logs constantly and will continue to do so for a least a week of 24/7 transfers to ensure the scheme works properly, before I start pushing real backup data. 

Regarding the original reported issue, if I understand correctly, this happens because the cleaning functionality happens to trigger in between 2 files copied from the same directory and finding the directory empty due to using writes mode, correct?
 The best way to fix it would be to check if new file copied has intermediate path directories available in cache and if not recreate the requested path so we can keep cleaning empty directories. But only if the copy has already failed once, so i/o performance is not affected.
I'm assuming cleaning function is running in its own thread so it needs to be paused from the moment a new file starts being copied to when it's fd is locked inside the cache directory since directories can not be locked.

Both those issue should be fixed here

https://beta.rclone.org/v1.38-192-g6d3df6f1/ (uploaded in 15-30 mins)

I've also checked all 96 of the possible open flags combinations and put some fixes in!
Thanks for testing - please open more issues if you find more problems!
